ambiguities.source_text: Simulate 12 months for each provider, with Month numbered from 1 to 12.
For this output, use a Customer Planned Deposit of 300 per month for every provider.
ambiguities.intent: Use planned monthly deposit 300 for this output.

ambiguities.source_text: If this value is greater than the Max Monthly Deposit allowed by the Provider
ambiguities.intent: Interest-bearing deposit is min(300, provider cap); leftover is max(300 minus deposit, 0).
Use annual decimal interest divided by 12.

ambiguities.source_text: make sure these leftovers are added on after the interest has been applied
ambiguities.intent: Each month add interest-bearing deposit, apply interest, then add leftover to a separate balance which never earns interest.
Max Possible Savings is month twelve total savings.
Total Interest is sum of interest credited to the interest-bearing balance.
Dense descending ranks of full-precision provider summary amounts, before output rounding.
